actions.maximum_inference_preserved: A finite record that promotes retrieval quality from sparse coverage and freshness while semantic-quality evidence is false fails the authored promotion predicate; no real quality effect follows.

semantic_basis: The retired theorem returns the structural, quality, runtime, memory, and parameter conjunction already supplied by StructuralClaimSeparated.
The immutable semantic overlay records no Lean dependency or theorem consumer for that projection.
The retained replacement unfolds the same partition predicate and derives contradiction when any required claim partition is explicitly absent.
The public structural-not-quality target now names that concrete finite rejection rather than the assumption-restating conjunction.
The migration proves no cyclic-mixer quality, runtime, memory, parameter efficiency, or hardware behavior.

target_migrations.old_target_text: A cyclic mixer claim records the structural invariant separately from quality, runtime, memory, and parameter claims.
target_migrations.new_target_text: A cyclic mixer review missing any structural, quality, runtime, memory, or parameter partition fails the finite structural-claim predicate.

actions.maximum_inference_preserved: A finite cyclic-mixer review with any required claim partition marked false fails StructuralClaimSeparated; no measured mechanism or resource advantage follows.

semantic_basis: The retired theorem applies BaselinesAndTradeoffsRequired to an already supplied promotion premise and returns the predicate consequence unchanged.
The immutable semantic overlay records no Lean dependency or theorem consumer for that projection.

target_migrations.old_target_text: A cyclic substrate cannot be promoted without ordinary baselines and recorded tradeoff metrics.
target_migrations.new_target_text: A promoted cyclic substrate missing baseline references or tradeoff metrics fails the finite promotion predicate.

actions.maximum_inference_preserved: A finite promoted record with missing baseline references or tradeoff metrics fails BaselinesAndTradeoffsRequired; no real candidate quality or adoption competence follows.

non_claims: Retiring a duplicate declaration does not strengthen the retained theorem.
Retiring a predicate projection does not turn its counterexample theorem into an empirical or deployed guarantee.
The retained theorems remain bounded consequences of authored finite records and predicates.
No theorem count is treated as a success metric.
No chapter-core support state, evidence transition, release state, or publication authority changes.
